title: Engineering standup
transcript:
Lee: The stream-stall fix is ready — long answers freezing mid-response. Ships Thursday, and Acme is watching, so no slips.
Sam: The blank-reply bug on rate limits is next in the queue after that. Same code path, half the fix comes free.
Lee: Eval nondeterminism needs seed plumbing — that's a design conversation, not a patch.
Sam: I'm documenting the ninety-day retention default this sprint. After that Lee, you wanted the usage summaries request?
Lee: Yes — once Thursday ships.
